notes_for_us: layout-intake says a tall tower cannot be framed in one top-down render and tells you to offer the decomposed alternative, but genre-choice makes course-tower the natural shape for exactly this prompt and never mentions the framing problem. The two skills point opposite ways on the most common obby there is, and nothing in the handoff records that the frame is a question.
The flag is the clearest case of the run-needs-an-end rule working: it is stated in the prompt, it maps straight onto winner-zone, and no goal question was needed.

Theme is genuinely null here and the skill's guidance holds — floating blocks in open space point at no setting at all — but it is worth noting that a null theme on an obby is close to a default rather than a gap.
